tokens.name: data-vis-01
tokens.usage: Categorical data color 1 of 14 (Purple 70). Apply categorical colors strictly in order 01, 02, 03... so neighbours keep their contrast; use 01-04 only for a fixed one-color group. Fills and lines in charts on `background` or `layer-01`, always with a legend or direct labels. Light-theme palette as published on carbondesignsystem.com; Carbon swaps to a dark palette on g90/g100 that the site does not publish as text, so this value is inherited there unverified.

spacing.note: Carbon mini-unit is 8px; spacing steps are multiples (rem, 16px base). Fluid spacing (0, 2vw, 5vw, 10vw) is not representable here: see README.

tokens.name: spacing-01
tokens.usage: 2px. Hairline gaps: icon-to-text in tags.

tokens.name: spacing-02
tokens.usage: 4px. Tight gaps inside compact controls.

tokens.name: spacing-03
tokens.usage: 8px. Default gap between inline elements; tag padding.

tokens.name: spacing-04
tokens.usage: 12px. Gaps between small related controls; large tag start padding.

tokens.name: spacing-05
tokens.usage: 16px. Default component padding (buttons, inputs, tiles) and gutter.

tokens.name: spacing-06
tokens.usage: 24px. Space between related groups; content padding in cards.

tokens.name: spacing-07
tokens.usage: 32px. Gap between sections inside a component.

tokens.name: spacing-08
tokens.usage: 40px. Large component gaps.

tokens.name: spacing-09
tokens.usage: 48px. Section spacing.

tokens.name: spacing-10

tokens.name: spacing-11

tokens.name: spacing-12
tokens.usage: 96px. Hero spacing.

tokens.name: spacing-13

radius.note: Carbon is square by default; radius appears only on tags, toggles and checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for buttons, inputs, tiles, notifications, modals (button-border-radius is 0).

tokens.name: radius-checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkbox box corners.

tokens.name: radius-toggle
tokens.usage: Default toggle track (48x24) pill radius.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Tag pill radius.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Toggle knob, radio buttons, avatar-like indicators.

breakpoint.note: Carbon 2x grid breakpoints (min-width). Columns: sm 4, md 8, lg/xlg/max 16. Margins: sm 0, md-xlg 16px, max 24px. Column padding 16px (32px gutters).

tokens.name: breakpoint-sm
tokens.usage: 320px. 4 columns, no outer margin. Smallest supported viewport.

tokens.name: breakpoint-md
tokens.usage: 672px. 8 columns, 16px margins. Breadcrumbs wrap from here; notifications grow to 608px.

tokens.name: breakpoint-lg
tokens.usage: 1056px. 16 columns, 16px margins. The UI shell side nav becomes persistent (rail/fixed) from here.

tokens.name: breakpoint-xlg
tokens.usage: 1312px. 16 columns, 16px margins.

tokens.name: breakpoint-max
tokens.usage: 1584px. 16 columns, 24px margins; fluid type reaches its largest step.

fluidSpacing.note: Fluid spacing scales with the viewport and is used between fluid sections on expressive pages, never inside components.

tokens.name: fluid-spacing-01
tokens.usage: No fluid space.

tokens.name: fluid-spacing-02
tokens.usage: Small fluid gap between sections.

tokens.name: fluid-spacing-03
tokens.usage: Medium fluid gap between sections.

tokens.name: fluid-spacing-04
tokens.usage: Large fluid gap between page sections.

duration.note: Carbon motion durations. Scale duration with the size of the change; honour prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast-01
tokens.usage: Micro-interactions: button and toggle state changes, hover, focus.

tokens.name: duration-fast-02
tokens.usage: Fades; small icon and chevron rotations.

tokens.name: duration-moderate-01
tokens.usage: Small expansions and short movements: accordion chevron, dropdown menus.

tokens.name: duration-moderate-02
tokens.usage: Expansions and system communication: toasts, modals, side panels.

tokens.name: duration-slow-01
tokens.usage: Large expansions and important system notifications.

tokens.name: duration-slow-02
tokens.usage: Background dimming and large, rare movements.

ease.note: Carbon easing curves. Productive for task UI (most of the product); expressive sparingly for significant moments.

tokens.name: ease-standard-productive
tokens.usage: Elements visible for the whole motion (expanding tiles, sorting rows) and panels that leave but stay nearby.

tokens.name: ease-entrance-productive
tokens.usage: Elements entering the view: menus, modals, toasts.

tokens.name: ease-exit-productive
tokens.usage: Elements leaving for good, such as a closing modal; speeds up as it leaves.

tokens.name: ease-standard-expressive
tokens.usage: Expressive standard motion for significant moments (opening a new page, a primary action).

tokens.name: ease-entrance-expressive
tokens.usage: Expressive entrance.

tokens.name: ease-exit-expressive
tokens.usage: Expressive exit.
